Claire (marketing): quick flag for Friday KPI deck  launch-post traffic up but MQL rate dipped on 4/10. Can someone triage? https://dash.redwood/boards/launch :mag:
Diego (growth): which step diverged? clicks->regs or regs->mql?
Claire (marketing): regs stable, regs->MQL dropped from 16% -> 10% in the 7-day window.
Maya (analytics): running a check. initial find: a short enrichment window 04/10 03:00-03:30 UTC had high `utm=(not set)` and lower profile completion.
Renee (ops): dashbot: enrichment-worker retries spike at 03:05 UTC; backlog cleared by 03:40 UTC. INC-2024-4110 opened.
-dashbot: recommendation  reprocess affected window `reproc_20240410_0345`.
Diego (growth): hold KPI headline until reproc completes. execs will want footnotes if we publish provisional numbers.
Maya (analytics): reproc kicked, ETA ~10m. I'll include crm_merge and bot-filter diffs in output.
Claire (marketing): thanks. if reproc restores counts we'll annotate the slide: "corrected after reprocessing (enrichment timeout)."
Maya (analytics): reproc done  pre=84 MQLs, post=119 MQLs. recovered_utm=28, crm_merges=2, reinstated_bots=5. CSV: https://internal/jobs/reproc_20240410_0345/export.csv
Diego (growth): ok good. consensus: headline = last-touch conservative number, appendix = time-decay and reproc details + infra note.
Claire (marketing): will update deck and add a 1-line annotation on the KPI board pointing to INC-2024-4110. Sending to execs once appendix attached. Thanks all :pray:
